title: Hi, I am Cat
intro: Catarina Silva, 26, from Portugal. Artist, illustrator and animator.

story.title: Witchy vibes and 00s nostalgia
story.text: That is the whole mood. I draw the dolls, cartoons and films I grew up with, a little spookier and a lot more sparkly than I remember them.

story.title: The obsession
story.text: Monster High is my biggest one. I am spending a whole Inktober drawing nothing else, and Clawdeen Wolf is still my favourite ghoul.

story.title: Fairy tales and cosy shows
story.text: Tangled, the Barbie films, Over the Garden Wall: anything with a good couple, a great villain or a strange world to get lost in ends up in my sketchbook.

story.title: The shop
story.text: My drawings become stickers, prints, photocards, keychains and standees. I pack every order myself.
